title: Every widget implementation should have his own page
body:
- HitsPerPage
- HitsPerPageSelect
- Range
- Range.Ratings

And possibly others, all have different props API even if some props are similar. We should provide them individual pages instead of trying to have them in the same documentation page.

This issues is linked to the default export strategy #1303, since the later will require creating new directories, new READMEs. That will help this issue.
